card.name: The word any after a preposition
card.fires_on: The word "any" right after a preposition such as for, at, of, in or to. It appears in label phrases like "for any indication", "at any time" and "to any of its ingredients".

modes.label: for/at any
modes.description: "any" after for or at, in phrases like "for any indication" or "at any time".
modes.example: All patients being treated with antidepressants for<< any>> indication should be monitored appropriately and observed closely

modes.label: of/to/in any
modes.description: "any" after of, to or in, before a noun or "of" phrase.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Fluticasone propionate nasal spray is contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to<< any>> of its ingredients

card.plain: It marks the word "any" in broad phrases such as "for any indication" or "at any time".
